type.markdownDescription:
### ⚠️ Requires [Provi's Origins](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki) to be installed! ⚠️

## Raycast Teleport

---

[Entity Action Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Raycast-Teleport)

Fires a raycast from the entity's looking direction and then teleports the entity to the block that it hits.

Type ID: `proviorigins:raycast_teleport`

## Fields

---

distance.description: The maximum distance of the raycast.
distance.markdownDescription: The maximum distance of the raycast.

destination.description: Either `"direct"` or `"on_top"`. Controls where the entity should be placed relative to the block hit by the raycast.
destination.markdownDescription: Either `"direct"` or `"on_top"`. Controls where the entity should be placed relative to the block hit by the raycast.

allow_water.description: Only applies if `destination` is set to `"on_top"`. Determines whether or not the entity is allowed to teleport into water.
allow_water.markdownDescription: Only applies if `destination` is set to `"on_top"`. Determines whether or not the entity is allowed to teleport into water.

allow_lava.description: Only applies if `destination` is set to `"on_top"`. Determines whether or not the entity is allowed to teleport into lava.
allow_lava.markdownDescription: Only applies if `destination` is set to `"on_top"`. Determines whether or not the entity is allowed to teleport into lava.

shape_type.description: Determines how the raycast interacts with shapes.
shape_type.markdownDescription: Determines how the raycast interacts with shapes.

fluid_handling.description: Determines how the raycast interacts with fluids.
fluid_handling.markdownDescription: Determines how the raycast interacts with fluids.

success_action.description: An action to execute on the entity after the raycast has hit a block and the entity teleported.
success_action.markdownDescription: An action to execute on the entity after the raycast has hit a block and the entity teleported.

miss_action.description: An action to execute on the entity if the raycast fails to hit a block or if the entity fails to teleport.
miss_action.markdownDescription: An action to execute on the entity if the raycast fails to hit a block or if the entity fails to teleport.

x-intellij-html-description:
Entity Action Type

Fires a raycast from the entity's looking direction and then teleports the entity to the block that it hits.

Type ID: proviorigins:raycast_teleport

Fields

Field Type Default Description
distance Float The maximum distance of the raycast.
destination String Either "direct" or "on_top". Controls where the entity should be placed relative to the block hit by the raycast.
allow_water Boolean false Only applies if destination is set to "on_top". Determines whether or not the entity is allowed to teleport into water.
allow_lava Boolean false Only applies if destination is set to "on_top". Determines whether or not the entity is allowed to teleport into lava.
shape_type Shape Type "outline" Determines how the raycast interacts with shapes.
fluid_handling Fluid Handling "any" Determines how the raycast interacts with fluids.
success_action Entity Action Type Optional An action to execute on the entity after the raycast has hit a block and the entity teleported.
miss_action Entity Action Type Optional An action to execute on the entity if the raycast fails to hit a block or if the entity fails to teleport.
